title: Futuristic mall in my neighbourhood🤔
content: Tonight i had a dream, where a completely new neighbourhood that exists in real life close to my house had a little cozy cafe. When i entered the cafe it turned out that i found myself in a giant 4, or more story mall- really modern, futuristic and besides stores the last floor had a stunning artistic instalation that looked like it was moving like a waterfall of rocks? It was completely sick and i wonder if i unlocked a new place on my dream map. Had anyone dreamed about something like this in their mallworlds? Do your malls also have entrances in familiar places you have in real life?
